column1: # vk_android_build.py: tool changes whose Android shader libraries are byte-identical to an earlier version's (vk_android_build.py vk_version, android/SHADERS.md#versions).
# A row is added only after a full build with the new tools reproduced the earlier library byte for byte; its digest is then that library's version.

column3: result cache, progress lines, ctypes seam (35331832 on e38a586a8a89): full DKB build 2026-11-03, dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical

the translator library checked by its source tree (xlate_tree.py), one translator call at a time for the library form (DMSH_VK_XLATE_J), the validator version in the result stamp, no result without a module or a reason, DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL: full DKB build 2026-11-03 with the library forms (ctypes), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical
stamp rows in the delta manifest (vk_android_delta.py stamp_only, restamped_header; --publish-delta writes them): full DKB and MKW 1.8.0 builds 2026-11-04, dmsh_vk.lib byte-identical

DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL takes the profile manifest's "-" shaders (not built in the Mac's full build) out of the failures, and the delta check takes such a shader not built as the manifest has it (vk_android_delta.py not_built_there, entry_as_manifest): full MKW 1.8.0 build 2026-11-05 with REQUIRE_ALL, dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical
PID temp file and not want cleanup guard: byte-identical results

a selected split's empty records have no key (record_key), and DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL=0 leaves out the shaders the package lacks (open_packs): full Pokopia key-list build (8,161 shaders) 2026-11-08, dmsh_vk.lib, _vk_build.json and vk_delta.tsv byte-identical (index.json names the kept entries' library, as every delta build does)

delta kept shaders written with one os.sync then renamed (sync_results), keep-stage progress and stage lines, stale temporary files of stopped key-list builds removed: OoT delta build 2026-11-11 keeping every shader from v-6257cc4482ac, dmsh_vk.lib, _vk_build.json and vk_delta.tsv byte-identical (index.json names the kept entries' library, as every delta build does)

the translator started through tool_lock.xlate_command (Linux: dotnet runs the portable dlls; the apphost in the repository is a Mach-O): full Mario Kart 8 Deluxe build on Linux 2026-11-21 (29,785 keys of shader_map.tsv, the 134 the package lacks left out, DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL=0, 29,651 shaders) byte-identical to the same full build with upstream's own tools on the Mac (SHA-256 7f1bc569e684efab467d000acb6bee68e89d00cf8ebd30a8644081e25869e336, both files 204,778,511 bytes); the lock's macOS-only metal rows do not affect the translation

the SPIR-V post-passes in C (libdmsh_spvn, vk_android_spv_native/spvn.c, through vk_android_spvn.py; the Python passes as the fallback): full builds on Linux 2026-11-28 with the native passes byte-identical to c1eff1d2d8c1 for dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json: Yoshi's Crafted World (23,497 shaders, SHA-256 31ad34f6428686f48de30ee29c19842993573fca13887811fcc97afba8fe9232), Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity (40,729, b2692d3c64df4c3a88b4338989c1e7d3d23f0e3e50b55beacb0e5988bcb2eb3b; 1 shader redone in Python), Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter (6,602 of 6,605 with DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL=0, the package lacks 3; 838caa77795244a1b7db117b6b10c11ae92f1270a22264e57aaa80be95285ea2); with DMSH_VK_SPVN=0 (the Python passes) Crafted World and Trails in the Sky byte-identical too
